links.comparator_used: Rubric-free Non Gold Rubric (Non-GR) scoring protocol
links.outcome: AI rater discriminative power for distinguishing DRG versus Baseline CDSS outputs in T2D pharmacotherapy evaluation
links.effect: GR amplified the AI rater's discrimination between DRG and Baseline CDSS outputs by factors of 1.76 to 5.10; under GR, mean scores were 7.69 to 49.64 points lower and interquartile ranges were 1.68 to 3.67 times wider than under Non-GR.
links.quote: Within each question, GR amplified the AI rater's discrimination between DRG and Baseline CDSS outputs by factors of 1.76 to 5.10, while also revealing substantial behavioral variation across rater models that Non-GR suppressed.

design_hint: rubric-anchored scoring protocol for LLM raters
